title: Mini Factory
mission: Simulate a three-station production line and investigate its bottleneck.
steps: Read a scenario and show station states and waiting queues.
Implement a bounded simulation engine separately from the display.
Add start, pause, reset and single-step controls; show simulated time and completions.
Change one processing time and compare two runs of the same duration.
checks: Pause stops simulated progress; reset restores the initial state.
Queues stay within capacity and every arrival is waiting, processing, completed or explicitly rejected.
validation: Compare throughput, maximum queue size and utilization using the same scenario duration.
extension: Experiment with buffer capacity or a seeded breakdown schedule.
hint: Start with one item and one simulated second per click. Specify how simultaneous events and blocked stations behave.
